crypto-service.test: AccountCreateTransaction Staked ID (#7) Creates an account with a staked account ID and a staked node ID
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects stakedAccountId together with stakedNodeId as mutually exclusive; the SDK keeps the last one set.

crypto-service.test: AccountDeleteTransaction Delete Account Id (#1) Deletes an account with no transfer account
crypto-service.reason: Core sends the balance to the operator when transferAccountId is omitted; the TCK expects ACCOUNT_ID_DOES_NOT_EXIST.

crypto-service.test: TransferTransaction - HBAR AddHbarTransfer (#8) Transfers 0 hbar from a sender account to a receiver account
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects a transfer amount of 0 ("amount must be positive.").

crypto-service.test: TransferTransaction - HBAR AddHbarTransfer (#14) Transfers an amount of hbar from a sender account to itself
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects a transfer to the sender itself as a no-op.

crypto-service.test: TransferTransaction - Token AddTokenTransfer (#11) Transfers 0 fungible token from a sender account to a receiver account
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects a transfer amount of 0 ("amount must be positive.").

crypto-service.test: TransferTransaction - Token AddTokenTransfer (#17) Transfers an amount of fungible token from a sender account to itself
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects a transfer to the sender itself as a no-op.

crypto-service.test: TransferTransaction - Token AddTokenTransferWithDecimals (#11) Transfers 0 fungible token from a sender account to a receiver account
crypto-service.reason: Core rejects a transfer amount of 0 ("amount must be positive.").

schedule-service.test: ScheduleDeleteTransaction Schedule ID (#2) Deletes a scheduled transaction without the admin key
schedule-service.reason: Core requires adminKey to cancel a schedule (INPUT_INVALID with INVALID_SIGNATURE); the TCK expects the network's SCHEDULE_IS_IMMUTABLE.

schedule-service.test: ScheduleDeleteTransaction Schedule ID (#8) Deletes a scheduled transaction that has already executed
schedule-service.reason: Core requires adminKey to cancel a schedule (INPUT_INVALID with INVALID_SIGNATURE); the TCK expects the network's SCHEDULE_ALREADY_EXECUTED.

node-service.reason: Core rejects a limit below 1 ("limit must be an integer >= 1"); the TCK expects the whole address book.
Not a core difference: the adapter answers with core's default address book (0.0.102), then the test's own consensusInfoClient.getAddressBook() without a fileId times out after 30s.
